# ============================================================
# PHASE 3 — COMPLETE DYNAMIC MODEL EVALUATION REPORT
#
# - Reads best checkpoints directly
# - Reads existing diagnostic DataFrames
# - Recomputes melody sensitivity on validation data
# - No hardcoded evaluation results
# - No training
# - No test-set evaluation
# - No collision with "comparison" DataFrame
# ============================================================

import pandas as pd
import torch

from pathlib import Path
from copy import deepcopy
from collections import defaultdict
from IPython.display import display, Markdown

NA = "—"

# ============================================================
# 1. MODEL REGISTRY
# ============================================================

CHORD_MODELS = {
    "Direct Unweighted": (
        "DIRECT_CHECKPOINT_PATH",
        "direct_history_df",
        "direct_model"
    ),
    "Direct Weighted": (
        "WEIGHTED_CHECKPOINT_PATH",
        "weighted_history_df",
        "weighted_model"
    ),
    "Flat 84-Class": (
        "JOINT_CHECKPOINT_PATH",
        "joint_history_df",
        "joint_model"
    ),
    "Temporal Weighted": (
        "TEMPORAL_CHECKPOINT_PATH",
        "temporal_history_df",
        "temporal_model"
    ),
    "Genre Weighted": (
        "GENRE_CHECKPOINT_PATH",
        "genre_history_df",
        "genre_model"
    ),
    "Temporal + Genre": (
        "COMBINED_CHECKPOINT_PATH",
        "combined_history_df",
        "combined_model"
    ),
}

FUNCTION_MODELS = {
    "Function Unweighted": (
        "UNWEIGHTED_FUNCTION_CHECKPOINT",
        "function_unweighted_history_df",
        "function_unweighted_model"
    ),
    "Function Weighted": (
        "FUNCTION_CHECKPOINT_PATH",
        "function_history_df",
        "function_model"
    ),
    "Function + Transition": (
        "TRANSITION_CHECKPOINT_PATH",
        "transition_history_df",
        "transition_model"
    ),
    "Function Half-Bar": (
        "HALFBAR_CHECKPOINT_PATH",
        "halfbar_history_df",
        "halfbar_model"
    ),
}

AR_MODELS = {
    "Initial Autoregressive": (
        "CHECKPOINT_PATH",
        "history_df",
        None
    ),
}

ALL_MODELS = {
    **AR_MODELS,
    **CHORD_MODELS,
    **FUNCTION_MODELS,
}

# ============================================================
# 2. LOAD SAVED CHECKPOINTS
# ============================================================

def p3_load_checkpoint(variable_name):
    path = globals().get(variable_name)

    if path is None:
        print(f"Checkpoint variable missing: {variable_name}")
        return None

    path = Path(path)

    if not path.is_file():
        print(f"Checkpoint file missing: {path}")
        return None

    try:
        return torch.load(
            path,
            map_location="cpu",
            weights_only=True
        )
    except Exception as error:
        print(f"Could not load {path.name}: {error}")
        return None


P3_CHECKPOINTS = {
    name: p3_load_checkpoint(info[0])
    for name, info in ALL_MODELS.items()
}

# ============================================================
# 3. DISPLAY AND METRIC HELPERS
# ============================================================

def p3_scalar(value):
    if value is None:
        return NA

    if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
        if value.numel() != 1:
            return NA
        value = value.item()

    if isinstance(value, float):
        return round(value, 4)

    return value


def p3_show_table(title, df, note=None):
    display(Markdown(f"### {title}"))

    if not isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) or df.empty:
        display(Markdown("*No results available.*"))
        return

    display(
        df.round(4).style.set_table_styles([
            {
                "selector": "th",
                "props": [
                    ("text-align", "left"),
                    ("white-space", "nowrap"),
                ]
            }
        ])
    )

    if note:
        display(Markdown(f"*{note}*"))


def p3_show_existing(title, variable, note=None):
    df = globals().get(variable)

    if isinstance(df, pd.DataFrame) and not df.empty:
        p3_show_table(title, df, note)
    else:
        print(
            f"Skipped: {title} "
            f"(DataFrame '{variable}' is unavailable)"
        )


def p3_get_metrics(model_name):
    checkpoint = P3_CHECKPOINTS.get(model_name)

    if not isinstance(checkpoint, dict):
        return {}

    return checkpoint.get("validation_metrics", {})


def p3_get_metric(model_name, *keys):
    metrics = p3_get_metrics(model_name)

    for key in keys:
        if key in metrics:
            return p3_scalar(metrics[key])

    return NA


def p3_get_epoch(model_name):
    checkpoint = P3_CHECKPOINTS.get(model_name)

    if not isinstance(checkpoint, dict):
        return NA

    return checkpoint.get("epoch", NA)


def p3_get_parameters(model_name):
    model_var = ALL_MODELS[model_name][2]

    if model_var is None:
        return NA

    model = globals().get(model_var)

    if model is None:
        return NA

    return sum(
        p.numel()
        for p in model.parameters()
        if p.requires_grad
    )


def p3_get_train_loss(model_name):
    _, history_var, _ = ALL_MODELS[model_name]

    history = globals().get(history_var)
    epoch = p3_get_epoch(model_name)

    if not isinstance(history, pd.DataFrame):
        return NA

    if epoch == NA or "epoch" not in history.columns:
        return NA

    selected = history.loc[
        history["epoch"] == epoch
    ]

    if selected.empty:
        return NA

    for key in [
        "weighted_train_loss",
        "train_loss",
    ]:
        if key in selected.columns:
            return p3_scalar(selected.iloc[0][key])

    return NA


def p3_metric_comparison(title, models, metric_map, note=None):
    rows = {}

    for label, keys in metric_map.items():
        if not isinstance(keys, tuple):
            keys = (keys,)

        rows[label] = {
            name: p3_get_metric(name, *keys)
            for name in models
        }

    df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(
        rows,
        orient="index"
    )

    df.index.name = "Evaluation Metric"

    p3_show_table(title, df, note)

    return df


def p3_training_summary(models):
    return pd.DataFrame({
        name: {
            "Best epoch": p3_get_epoch(name),
            "Train loss at best epoch": p3_get_train_loss(name),
            "Trainable parameters": p3_get_parameters(name),
        }
        for name in models
    })


# ============================================================
# 4. REPORT HEADER
# ============================================================

display(Markdown(
    "# PHASE 3 — DYNAMIC TRANSFORMER EVALUATION REPORT"
))

loaded = [
    name
    for name, checkpoint in P3_CHECKPOINTS.items()
    if checkpoint is not None
]

print(
    f"Successfully loaded {len(loaded)} "
    f"of {len(ALL_MODELS)} checkpoints."
)

# ============================================================
# 5. DATASET AND CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================

dataset_rows = {}

for variable in [
    "train_dataset",
    "val_dataset",
    "test_dataset",
]:
    dataset = globals().get(variable)

    if dataset is not None:
        dataset_rows[variable] = len(dataset)

if dataset_rows:
    p3_show_table(
        "1. Dataset Sizes",
        pd.DataFrame.from_dict(
            dataset_rows,
            orient="index",
            columns=["Number of Windows"]
        )
    )

config_names = [
    "D_MODEL",
    "NUM_ENCODER_LAYERS",
    "NUM_DECODER_LAYERS",
    "NUM_ATTENTION_HEADS",
    "DIM_FEEDFORWARD",
    "DROPOUT",
    "LEARNING_RATE",
    "WEIGHT_DECAY",
    "GRAD_CLIP_NORM",
    "EARLY_STOPPING_PATIENCE",
    "TEMPORAL_SIGMA",
    "TEMPORAL_STRENGTH",
    "TRANSITION_LOSS_WEIGHT",
    "TRANSITION_POS_WEIGHT",
]

config_rows = {
    name: globals()[name]
    for name in config_names
    if name in globals()
}

if config_rows:
    p3_show_table(
        "2. Hyperparameters",

# ============================================================
# 7. MELODY INPUT SENSITIVITY — RECOMPUTE DIRECTLY
#
# IMPORTANT:
# This replaces the earlier comparison.copy() approach.
#
# It independently evaluates the saved best Direct
# Unweighted Transformer on original and shuffled melody.
#
# Original beat grids and chord targets remain unchanged.
# No training or test-set evaluation.
# ============================================================

def p3_evaluate_melody_sensitivity():

    required = [
        "direct_model",
        "val_loader",
        "compute_harmony_loss",
    ]

    missing = [
        name for name in required
        if name not in globals()
    ]

    checkpoint = P3_CHECKPOINTS.get("Direct Unweighted")

    if checkpoint is None or missing:
        print(
            "Melody sensitivity unavailable. Missing:",
            missing if missing else "Direct checkpoint"
        )
        return None, None

    # Separate evaluation copy of the network.
    # Load the BEST saved checkpoint, not the final epoch.
    model = deepcopy(direct_model)

    model.load_state_dict(
        checkpoint["model_state_dict"]
    )

    # CPU evaluation prevents device mismatch between
    # the model and the DataLoader tensors.
    model = model.to("cpu")
    model.eval()

    input_keys = [
        "melody_pitch",
        "melody_time",
        "melody_padding_mask",
        "beat_time",
        "bar_index",
        "beat_position",
        "meter",
        "beat_padding_mask",
    ]

    stats = defaultdict(float)

    with torch.no_grad():

        for batch in val_loader:

            batch = {
                key: value.cpu()
                if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor)
                else value
                for key, value in batch.items()
            }

            inputs = {
                key: batch[key]
                for key in input_keys
            }

            true_root = batch["target_root"]
            true_family = batch["target_family"]
            valid = batch["target_valid_mask"]

            n_valid = int(valid.sum().item())

            if n_valid == 0:
                continue

            stats["valid_beats"] += n_valid

            # -------------------------------------
            # A. Original melody
            # -------------------------------------

            root_logits, family_logits = model(inputs)

            pred_root = root_logits.argmax(dim=-1)
            pred_family = family_logits.argmax(dim=-1)

            stats["original_root"] += (
                ((pred_root == true_root) & valid)
                .sum().item()
            )

            stats["original_family"] += (
                ((pred_family == true_family) & valid)
                .sum().item()
            )

            stats["original_joint"] += (
                (
                    (pred_root == true_root)
                    & (pred_family == true_family)
                    & valid
                )
                .sum().item()
            )

            original_loss = compute_harmony_loss(
                root_logits,
                family_logits,
                true_root,
                true_family
            )["total"]

            stats["original_loss"] += (
                original_loss.item() * n_valid
            )

            # -------------------------------------
            # B. Shuffled melody
            # -------------------------------------

            # Rotate entire melodies among examples
            # in the same batch.
            #
            # Both pitch and note timing are replaced.
            # Beat inputs and reference chords stay fixed.

            shuffled_inputs = dict(inputs)

            batch_size = inputs[
                "melody_pitch"
            ].shape[0]

            if batch_size < 2:
                raise ValueError(
                    "A validation batch contains only one window. "
                    "The original within-batch rotation requires "
                    "at least two examples."
                )

            permutation = torch.roll(
                torch.arange(batch_size),
                shifts=1
            )

            for key in [
                "melody_pitch",
                "melody_time",
                "melody_padding_mask",
            ]:
                shuffled_inputs[key] = (
                    inputs[key][permutation]
                )

            shuffled_root_logits, shuffled_family_logits = (
                model(shuffled_inputs)
            )

            shuffled_root = (
                shuffled_root_logits.argmax(dim=-1)
            )

            shuffled_family = (
                shuffled_family_logits.argmax(dim=-1)
            )

            stats["shuffled_root"] += (
                ((shuffled_root == true_root) & valid)
                .sum().item()
            )

            stats["shuffled_family"] += (
                ((shuffled_family == true_family) & valid)
                .sum().item()
            )

            stats["shuffled_joint"] += (
                (
                    (shuffled_root == true_root)
                    & (shuffled_family == true_family)
                    & valid
                )
                .sum().item()
            )

            # Prediction-change rate
            prediction_changed = (
                (shuffled_root != pred_root)
                | (shuffled_family != pred_family)
            )

            stats["prediction_changed"] += (
                (prediction_changed & valid)
                .sum().item()
            )

            shuffled_loss = compute_harmony_loss(
                shuffled_root_logits,
                shuffled_family_logits,
                true_root,
                true_family
            )["total"]

            stats["shuffled_loss"] += (
                shuffled_loss.item() * n_valid
            )

    n = stats["valid_beats"]

    if n == 0:
        return None, None

    # Actual measured evaluation results
    df = pd.DataFrame([
        {
            "Input": "Original melody",
            "Root accuracy": stats["original_root"] / n,
            "Family accuracy": stats["original_family"] / n,
            "Joint accuracy": stats["original_joint"] / n,
            "Validation loss": stats["original_loss"] / n,
        },
        {
            "Input": "Shuffled melody",
            "Root accuracy": stats["shuffled_root"] / n,
            "Family accuracy": stats["shuffled_family"] / n,
            "Joint accuracy": stats["shuffled_joint"] / n,
            "Validation loss": stats["shuffled_loss"] / n,
        },
    ])

    change_rate = (
        stats["prediction_changed"] / n
    )

    return df, change_rate


print("\nEvaluating original vs shuffled melody...")
print("This runs validation inference, not training.")

try:
    (
        phase3_melody_sensitivity_df,
        phase3_melody_prediction_change_rate
    ) = p3_evaluate_melody_sensitivity()

except Exception as error:
    print("Melody sensitivity evaluation failed:", error)
    phase3_melody_sensitivity_df = None
    phase3_melody_prediction_change_rate = None

if phase3_melody_sensitivity_df is not None:

    p3_show_table(
